name: discord-orca
description: Discord channel for Claude Code (orca fork). Adds gate env vars: DISCORD_ONLY_CHATS (only these chat ids), DISCORD_TOP_LEVEL_ONLY + DISCORD_THREAD_REGISTRY (drop thread messages whose registry entry is active), DISCORD_PRESENCE (custom status text), DISCORD_IGNORE_OTHER_BOT_MENTIONS (drop messages that mention another bot but not this one).
